g.text: RCC Institute of Information Technology (RCCIIT), Kolkata • Graduated July 2026 (CGPA 7.15)

text.tspan: I build interactive web applications, browser games, and embedded hardware prototypes.
Through an Information Systems internship at Haldia Petrochemicals Limited, I built practical foundations in
computer networking (IP addressing, routing, switching, DNS/DHCP), troubleshooting, and cybersecurity fundamentals.
Currently seeking entry-level IT support, network administration, cybersecurity, and web development roles.
